data.description:
## Context

Deferred non-blocking advisories from the change-triggered criterion-eval work (ticket 5169,
epic R-4 `spin-cub-usher` / 65dd-e93b-666a-4caa). Each was dispositioned defer-followup: all
are non-blocking, LLM-Review+1 was granted, the `eval-changed-rubrics` job is
continue-on-error, and CI itself uses ANTHROPIC/OPENAI credentials so the gating is correct
for CI today. They matter for portability (non-CI / Bedrock-only environments) and test
coverage, so they are collected here rather than dropped.

## Scope

`src/rebar/_cli/_llm_eval_commands.py` (the live criteria-eval availability check and the
change-triggered run loop) and its unit tests.

## Deferred items to disposition

- [ ] `_live_criteria_eval_available` gates on ANTHROPIC/OPENAI env only; a Bedrock repo
      model with Bedrock creds is seen as "no live", so a Bedrock-only environment silently
      skips the live half.
- [ ] Fail-open: when live is available but every criterion raises LLMError, the run returns
      None and the caller exits 0 unconditionally, even under `--require-live`.
- [ ] Empty `--changed-since ''` is not treated as a null ref; it falls through to the
      missing-criterion error (exit 2) instead of a clean no-op.
- [ ] The per-criterion LLMError recovery path in the live-run loop has no test.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Each item above is either fixed (with a covering test where it is a correctness or
      coverage gap) or explicitly accepted with a one-line reason recorded on this ticket.
      In particular, decide whether `--require-live` must fail non-zero when live was
      available but produced no successful evaluation.

## Budget

To be estimated when claimed.
data.title: Follow-up: live criteria-eval availability gating and fail-open under --require-live (R-4)
